messages:
mia: heads up — drilldown 'context anchor' links in the scorecard diff are pointing to the wrong sample slices after the latest quant runs
raj: repro? which run id?
mia: saw it on ci/qp-238 (fp8 experiment). heatmap overlay anchors to sample offset that doesn't match exported sample IDs
leo: could be exporter vs UI indexing mismatch (0-based vs 1-based) or we lost the original sample_uuid in the artifact
ci-bot: runner-export finished for ci/qp-238 — artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/ci_qp_238/2026-03-18/  (10,128 samples)
mia: minimal repro: open scorecard diff, click a heatmap cell -> right panel shows sample #451 but `artifact/samples.csv` row 451 belongs to different input
anya: any quick mitigation? we can fallback to searching by text hash if UUID missing
raj: upload snippet?
mia: here's the export header we use: `index, sample_uuid, prompt_hash, input, output, label`
leo: ok, UI uses `index` to anchor — if runner exported an off-by-one index earlier in the pipeline that would misalign after quantization merges
raj: I dug through the runner: in export.py we append rows inside a loop that increments before write, so index starts at 1 but UI expects 0. classic.
mia: nice catch. two fixes: patch exporter to emit zero-based index and add explicit sample_uuid column in all artifacts; update UI to prefer sample_uuid when present
anya: can we hotfix UI to lookup by sample_uuid first, fall back to index?
leo: created PR 4217 with exporter fix (tests + migration script).
mia: I'll open a tiny UI PR to prefer uuid lookup and add a safety check for index bounds.
ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for PR 4217 -> staging
ci-bot: staging deploy succeeded (2026-03-20T15:42:10Z)
mia: verified on staging — anchors now match sample UUIDs for several quant runs. rolling to prod after smoke tests. :tada:
raj: please add a short note in the release changelog and an eval-harness migration guide entry
mia: will do. thanks y'all.
